title: Step into your project
story: Welcome to Geiss-01. You land in your home folder. Your design project lives in a folder called {{project}}.

files.~/notes.txt: Remember: cd moves you, pwd tells you where you are.

tasks.text: Confirm where you are with pwd

hints: `cd` (change directory) moves you into a folder. Type `ls` first to see the folder names.
Type `cd` followed by a space and the folder name. Tab completes it for you.
